verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB is a managed ClickHouse database service, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. The only MCP evidence (docs-7) describes ObsessionDB serving MCP tools to external coding agents. That is server-side and does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
